t: Traditionally united by Harald Fairhair around 872, Norway became a Christian kingdom under Olaf Tryggvason and Saint Olaf.
Its medieval realm reached from Greenland to the Baltic, and Magnus the Lawmender gave it a national law code in 1274.
After union with Denmark from 1380 and with Sweden from 1814, Norway became fully independent again in 1905.
dyk: When Magnus Erlingsson was crowned in Bergen in 1163 or 1164, it was the first royal coronation held anywhere in Scandinavia.
ev: Harald Fairhair wins the Battle of Hafrsfjord, by tradition uniting Norway
Olaf Haraldsson is killed at Stiklestad and soon venerated as Saint Olaf
Iceland submits to the Norwegian crown, following Greenland
Magnus the Lawmender issues a national law code
Olaf IV inherits Norway, beginning the union with Denmark
The Eidsvoll constitution is adopted; Norway enters union with Sweden
The union with Sweden is dissolved and Haakon VII becomes king
Germany occupies Norway; the king and government continue the war from London
